senses.en: (dated) a woman teacher, especially one regarded as strict
senses.zh: （旧时用法）女教师（尤指严格的）

example.en: The village schoolmistress ran her classroom with strict discipline.
example.zh: 村里的女教师以严格的纪律管理课堂。

senses.en: items used to make a place look more attractive

example.en: They put up Christmas decorations in the living room.
example.zh: 他们在客厅里挂上了圣诞装饰品。

senses.en: a dough of flour, fat and water used for pies and tarts

example.en: Roll out the pastry on a floured surface.
example.zh: 在撒了面粉的台面上把油酥面团擀开。

senses.en: a small sweet baked food made with this dough

example.en: She bought pastries for breakfast.
example.zh: 她买了些糕点当早餐。

senses.en: not producing the intended result

example.en: The medicine proved ineffective against the virus.
example.zh: 这种药被证明对病毒无效。

senses.en: a failure to understand something correctly

example.en: The argument was just a misunderstanding between friends.
example.zh: 那场争吵只是朋友之间的误会。

senses.en: a person who commits crimes or acts dishonestly

example.en: The salesman turned out to be a crook.
example.zh: 那个推销员原来是个骗子。

senses.en: a hooked or bent shape, object, or staff
senses.zh: 钩形物；弯曲部分；（牧羊人的）弯柄杖

example.en: The shepherd held a crook in his hand.
example.zh: 牧羊人手里握着一根曲柄杖。

senses.en: to bend, especially a limb or finger

example.en: She crooked her finger to beckon him over.
example.zh: 她弯起手指招呼他过来。

senses.en: slowly, over a period of time

example.en: The weather gradually improved during the afternoon.
example.zh: 下午天气逐渐好转。

senses.en: a cylindrical container that holds liquids

example.en: They stored rainwater in a barrel.
example.zh: 他们把雨水储存在一个桶里。

senses.en: the tube through which a bullet travels in a gun

example.en: The bullet traveled down the barrel.
example.zh: 子弹沿枪管射出。

senses.en: to put something into barrels

example.en: The winery barrels the wine for aging.
example.zh: 酒厂把葡萄酒装桶陈酿。

senses.en: a dry substance made of very small loose particles

example.en: She mixed the cocoa powder with warm milk.
example.zh: 她把可可粉与温牛奶混合。

senses.en: to crush or grind something into very small particles

example.en: The recipe says to powder the dried chilies before adding them.
example.zh: 食谱上说在加入干辣椒之前先把它磨成粉。

senses.en: to apply powder to the skin or face

example.en: She powdered her face before the photo.
example.zh: 拍照前她在脸上扑了粉。

senses.en: very much; to a large degree

example.en: The new policy greatly improved air quality in the city.
example.zh: 新政策大大改善了该市的空气质量。

senses.en: to ask for money or food as charity

example.en: She begs on the street every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早晨在街上乞讨。

senses.en: to ask for something earnestly or urgently

example.en: He begged her to stay.
example.zh: 他恳求她留下。

senses.en: a radio, television, or online program transmitted to an audience
senses.zh: 广播或电视节目；网络播送节目

example.en: We watched a live broadcast of the match.
example.zh: 我们观看了比赛的现场直播。

senses.en: to transmit a program or message to an audience by radio, television, or the internet

example.en: The ceremony will be broadcast on national television.
example.zh: 这场仪式将通过电视向全国播出。

senses.en: a male ruler of a country

example.en: The king greeted his people from the balcony.
example.zh: 国王在阳台上向民众致意。

senses.en: the most important chess piece that must be protected from checkmate

example.en: He moved his king to a safer square.
example.zh: 他把王移到更安全的格子。

senses.en: a person considered the most important or successful in a particular field
senses.zh: （某领域中的）王者，最杰出的人物

example.en: He became known as the king of comedy.
example.zh: 他被称为喜剧之王。

senses.en: to be the largest, most important, or most noticeable part of something
senses.zh: 在数量、重要性或影响力上占主导地位

example.en: The company dominates the local software market.
example.zh: 这家公司主导着当地的软件市场。

senses.en: to have or use power and control over someone or something

example.en: The stronger team dominated the game from the start.
example.zh: 更强的球队从一开始就控制了比赛。

senses.en: to make someone unable to see clearly with very bright light

example.en: The headlights dazzled the driver for a moment.
example.zh: 车灯让司机一时看不清。

senses.en: to impress someone greatly with skill, beauty or intelligence

example.en: Her performance dazzled the whole audience.
example.zh: 她的表演令全场观众赞叹不已。

senses.en: very bright light that makes it hard to see

example.en: The dazzle of the camera flashes filled the room.
example.zh: 相机闪光灯的强光照满了房间。

senses.en: generous in giving money or help to people in need

example.en: A philanthropic foundation funded the new library.
example.zh: 一家慈善基金会资助了新图书馆的建设。

senses.en: relating to or characterized by philanthropy

example.en: His philanthropic efforts improved many lives.
example.zh: 他的公益努力改善了许多人的生活。

senses.en: arranged like rays, spreading out from a center

example.en: The city has a radial road system spreading from the center.
example.zh: 这座城市有一个从中心向外放射的道路系统。

senses.en: moving or directed along a radius, from the center outward

example.en: The engine experiences radial forces as it spins.
example.zh: 发动机旋转时会受到径向力。

senses.en: relating to the radius (the bone in the forearm)

example.en: The doctor checked the radial pulse at the wrist.
example.zh: 医生检查了手腕处的桡动脉脉搏。

senses.en: a tire with radial-ply construction

example.en: My car needs new radial tires for winter.
example.zh: 我的车冬天需要新的子午线轮胎。

senses.en: made better than before

example.en: The improved design uses less fuel.
example.zh: 改进后的设计更省油。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of improve: became or made better
senses.zh: 改善；提高（improve 的过去式和过去分词）

example.en: His English improved a lot last year.
example.zh: 他的英语去年进步很大。

senses.en: a score in American football when a player carries or catches the ball into the end zone, worth six points

example.en: The team scored a touchdown in the final seconds of the game.
example.zh: 球队在比赛最后几秒钟完成了一次触地得分。

senses.en: the moment an aircraft's wheels make contact with the ground when landing

example.en: Passengers applauded after a smooth touchdown.
example.zh: 飞机平稳着陆后，乘客们鼓起了掌。

senses.en: according to claims that have not been proven

example.en: The painting was allegedly stolen from a museum years ago.
example.zh: 据称这幅画多年前从一家博物馆被盗。

senses.en: the largest city in Australia, capital of New South Wales
senses.zh: 悉尼（澳大利亚最大城市，新南威尔士州首府）

example.en: Sydney is famous for its Opera House and harbour.
example.zh: 悉尼以歌剧院和海港闻名。

senses.en: an object used to keep something from falling or shaking

example.en: He used a wooden prop to hold the door up.
example.zh: 他用一根木支柱把门撑住。

senses.en: a movable object used on the set of a play or film

example.en: The actors arranged the props before rehearsal.
example.zh: 演员们在排练前布置好了道具。

senses.en: to support something by leaning it against something solid

example.en: She propped her bike against the wall.
example.zh: 她把自行车靠在墙上。

senses.en: existing or happening in the period after a war, especially World War II

example.en: The city rebuilt many neighborhoods in the postwar years.
example.zh: 这座城市在战后岁月里重建了许多街区。

senses.en: extremely importantly; to a crucial degree
senses.zh: 极其重要地；至关重要地

example.en: Good communication is vitally important in a team.
example.zh: 良好的沟通在团队中至关重要。

senses.en: the day of the week between Tuesday and Thursday

example.en: The meeting is on Wednesday.
example.zh: 会议在星期三举行。

senses.en: (of a seed) to start growing; to begin to develop

example.en: The seeds germinated after a week of warm rain.
example.zh: 经过一周温暖的降雨后，种子发芽了。

senses.en: the process of breathing, or of cells producing energy

example.en: The nurse recorded the patient's rate of respiration.
example.zh: 护士记录了病人的呼吸频率。

senses.en: the star-shaped symbol * used in writing and printing

example.en: Put an asterisk next to the items that need checking.
example.zh: 在需要核对的条目旁边加上星号。

senses.en: to mark something with an asterisk

example.en: Please asterisk the words that are new to you.
example.zh: 请用星号标出你不认识的词。

senses.en: a woman who works in business, especially at a professional level

example.en: She is a successful businesswoman who runs her own company.
example.zh: 她是一位经营自己公司的成功女商人。

senses.en: with strong emotion, e.g. anger or excitement

example.en: They argued hotly about the new rules.
example.zh: 他们就新规则激烈地争论。

senses.en: eagerly or intensely

example.en: The prize is hotly contested every year.
example.zh: 这项奖项每年都竞争激烈。

senses.en: a person who rules a country temporarily when the monarch is absent, ill, or a child

example.en: The prince was too young to rule, so a regent governed in his name.
example.zh: 王子年幼不能执政，由摄政者代为治理。

senses.en: a member of a governing board of a university or institution (US)
senses.zh: （美国大学等的）董事会成员，评议员

example.en: She was appointed to the board of regents of the state university.
example.zh: 她被任命为州立大学董事会的成员。

senses.en: to carry or keep something in your hand or arms

example.en: She held the baby gently.
example.zh: 她轻轻地抱着婴儿。

senses.en: to contain something or have enough space for people

example.en: This bottle holds two liters of water.
example.zh: 这个瓶子能装两升水。

senses.en: to organize or conduct an event, meeting, or election

example.en: The committee will hold a meeting tomorrow.
example.zh: 委员会明天将召开会议。

senses.en: a firm grip on something or control over it

example.en: He kept a tight hold on the rope.
example.zh: 他紧紧抓住绳子。

senses.en: to get something by paying money for it

example.en: She bought a new phone yesterday.
example.zh: 她昨天买了一部新手机。

senses.en: something bought, especially a good deal
senses.zh: 所购之物；（尤指）划算的买卖

example.en: This jacket was a good buy.
example.zh: 这件夹克买得很划算。

senses.en: to believe or accept something, often informally

example.en: I don't buy his excuse.
example.zh: 我不相信他的借口。

senses.en: a machine or device used in the home for a particular job

example.en: The kitchen has several new appliances, including a dishwasher.
example.zh: 厨房里有几件新电器，包括一台洗碗机。

senses.en: a device or piece of equipment used for a specific purpose

example.en: The dentist fitted a small appliance to correct her bite.
example.zh: 牙医安装了一个小器具来矫正她的咬合。

senses.en: the warmest season of the year

example.en: We plan to travel by train this summer.
example.zh: 我们计划今年夏天坐火车旅行。

senses.en: suitable for or typical of summer

example.en: She packed a light summer dress for the trip.
example.zh: 她为这次旅行带了一条轻便的夏装连衣裙。

senses.en: to spend the summer in a place

example.en: They summer in a small village near the coast.
example.zh: 他们在海边的一个小村庄过夏。

senses.en: to clean something by rubbing it hard with a brush or cloth

example.en: She scrubbed the kitchen floor until it was spotless.
example.zh: 她把厨房地板擦洗得一尘不染。

senses.en: the act of cleaning something by hard rubbing

example.en: Give the table a good scrub before dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭前把桌子好好擦洗一下。

senses.en: land covered with low stunted trees and bushes

example.en: They hiked through the dry scrub for hours.
example.zh: 他们在干燥的灌木丛中徒步了好几个小时。

senses.en: to go around an area regularly to keep it safe or watch for trouble

example.en: Police officers patrol the streets at night.
example.zh: 警察夜间在街道上巡逻。

senses.en: the act of going around an area to keep it safe, or a group of people doing this

example.en: A border patrol stopped the truck for inspection.
example.zh: 边境巡逻队拦下卡车进行检查。

senses.en: as a result; because of that

example.en: It rained heavily; consequently, the match was postponed.
example.zh: 雨下得很大，因此比赛被推迟了。

senses.en: a small flat case used for carrying money, cards and ID

example.en: He took a five-dollar bill out of his wallet.
example.zh: 他从钱包里拿出一张五美元的纸币。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually for pleasure

example.en: We had a picnic by the river on Sunday.
example.zh: 周日我们在河边野餐。

senses.en: to have a meal outdoors

example.en: They picnicked in the park last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天他们在公园里野餐。

senses.en: something that is very easy (informal)

example.en: The exam was no picnic, but I passed.
example.zh: 这场考试可不轻松，但我通过了。

senses.en: a person who helps someone do a task or job

example.en: We need a helper to set up the stage.
example.zh: 我们需要一个帮手来布置舞台。

senses.en: able to speak two languages equally well, or written in two languages
senses.zh: 会说两种语言的；双语的

example.en: She grew up bilingual in English and Spanish.
example.zh: 她从小就会说英语和西班牙语两种语言。

senses.en: a person who speaks two languages fluently

example.en: Bilinguals often switch easily between languages.
example.zh: 双语者常能在两种语言间自如切换。

senses.en: extremely beautiful or astonishing
senses.zh: 惊人的；令人叹为观止的

example.en: We enjoyed a breathtaking view from the mountaintop.
example.zh: 我们在山顶欣赏了令人叹为观止的景色。

senses.en: relating to ordinary life and material things rather than spiritual matters

example.en: He gave up worldly pleasures to live a simple life.
example.zh: 他放弃了世俗的享乐，过着简朴的生活。

senses.en: experienced and sophisticated about life

example.en: She was surprisingly worldly for someone so young.
example.zh: 她年纪轻轻却意外地老练世故。

senses.en: the belief that all events are predetermined and cannot be changed

example.en: His fatalism made him accept setbacks without complaint.
example.zh: 他的宿命论让他毫无怨言地接受挫折。

senses.en: dislike or fear of foreigners or strangers

example.en: The government launched a campaign against racism and xenophobia.
example.zh: 政府发起了一场反对种族主义和排外情绪的运动。

senses.en: the green substance in plants that absorbs light to make food

example.en: Chlorophyll makes leaves green and helps plants produce energy from sunlight.
example.zh: 叶绿素使叶子呈绿色，帮助植物从阳光中获取能量。

senses.en: the state of not being able to move or not moving

example.en: After the accident, he suffered weeks of immobility.
example.zh: 事故之后，他经历了数周无法动弹的日子。

senses.en: done secretly or quietly to avoid being noticed

example.en: She took a surreptitious glance at her phone during class.
example.zh: 她在课堂上偷偷瞥了一眼手机。

senses.en: in a very careful and thorough way, paying attention to every detail

example.en: She meticulously checked every line of the report.
example.zh: 她细致地核对了报告的每一行。

senses.en: a device in a vehicle that shows how far it has travelled

example.en: The mileometer showed that the car had travelled 60,000 miles.
example.zh: 里程表显示这辆车已行驶了六万英里。

senses.en: allowing books or notes to be used, as in an exam; fully transparent

example.en: The final exam is open-book, so you can use your notes.
example.zh: 期末考试是开卷的，所以你可以使用笔记。

senses.en: Saturday and Sunday, especially when considered as a break from work

example.en: We spent the weekend at the lake.
example.zh: 我们在湖边度过了周末。

senses.en: to spend or pass the weekend somewhere

example.en: They often weekend at their cottage in the mountains.
example.zh: 他们常在山间小屋度周末。

senses.en: on weekends; every weekend

example.en: The café is crowded weekends.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆周末总是很挤。
